incident.observed_error: extension economics do not reconcile to actual net PnL
incident.behavior: The writer retained the last complete checkpoint while the source ledgers continued advancing.
incident.capital_impact: none observed; the HYPE close and SP500 protection continued under the live backend

root_cause.explanation: The extension projector recomputed realized gross from rounded aggregate entry and exit prices. Hyperliquid's exact partial-fill closed PnL differed by $0.004516, so the fail-closed five-microdollar reconciliation rejected an otherwise authoritative close.

repair.method: Aggregate exact per-fill closed_pnl_usd and use it as authoritative realized gross while retaining the rounded-price estimate and gap as explicit telemetry.
strict_checks_preserved: authoritative gross minus fees plus funding equals reflected net PnL

validation.red_test: test_venue_close_pnl_survives_aggregate_price_rounding failed with the production reconciliation error before implementation
validation.green_test: The same test passed after exact closed-PnL aggregation

uncertainties_risks_and_failure_modes: The replacement checkpoint writer is report-only and was reloaded independently of the original TUI supervisor after the original writer was stopped.
A future venue schema that omits closed_pnl_usd would produce zero authoritative gross and fail reconciliation rather than silently infer it.
The repair validates the current Hyperliquid partial-fill shape but does not establish strategy profitability.
The still-open SP500 lifecycle can change the accounting epoch after this checkpoint.
falsifier: The repair is falsified if a complete source ledger prefix with exact fill closed PnL, fees, and funding cannot reproduce reflected net PnL; if checkpoint generation stalls again on the same lifecycle; if the epoch diverges from 3 closes and +$7.505202 at this prefix; or if the live backend, routing, or venue orders changed during the report-only reload.

change_proposal.Recommendation: Retain the exact closed-PnL projector repair and continue the v51 run without changing strategy parameters.
change_proposal.Why now: A resolved profitable HYPE lifecycle was durable in the ledgers but invisible in the TUI because the checkpoint intentionally retained its last complete projection.
change_proposal.Evidence reviewed: Exact HYPE asset ledger, cohort ledger, two close fills, fee and funding rows, reflected lifecycle, old and repaired checkpoints, accounting archive, and live process identity.
change_proposal.Observed problem or opportunity: Rounded aggregate prices differed from authoritative per-fill closed PnL by $0.004516, blocking all newer telemetry despite correct execution.
change_proposal.Applicable market regime: Technical accounting behavior; independent of market regime and applicable to any partially filled close.
change_proposal.Alternatives considered: Loosen the money tolerance, omit extension outcomes, mutate the ledger, restart the trading backend, or use exact venue closed PnL.
change_proposal.Proposed live change: No strategy or execution change; retain the projector-only correction already reloaded under the user's preapproved defect authority.
change_proposal.Expected upside: Continuous honest TUI/accounting updates without weakening exact fee, funding, size, or realized-PnL checks.
change_proposal.Main risks and failure modes: Missing future venue fields, lifecycle cleanup of the independently reloaded writer, and unrelated accounting failures being mistaken for the fixed rounding case.
change_proposal.Validation completed: Red-green regression, 91 focused tests, static checks, exact real-ledger checkpoint build, live writer reload, archive rebuild, and TUI source checkpoint reconciliation.
change_proposal.Validation still required: Observe at least one additional partial-fill close and verify continued checkpoint publication through the eventual SP500 close.
change_proposal.Success metrics: Checkpoint age remains below its stale threshold; each close increments the complete epoch exactly once; net PnL reconciles to venue closed PnL minus fees plus funding; no strategy process restart occurs.
change_proposal.Failure / rollback triggers: Repeated same error, missing closed-PnL evidence, duplicate close attribution, stale checkpoint, profile/epoch mismatch, or any effect on execution authority.
change_proposal.Confidence level: High on the root cause and current repair from exact production arithmetic and successful replay; medium on future venue-schema compatibility until another independent close is observed.
change_proposal.Explicit approval requested: No additional approval requested because the user preapproved corrective changes for bugs that reduce correctness or profitability, and this repair changes only report-only projection logic.

single_highest_value_next_investigation: Verify the next resolved SP500 lifecycle increments the same accounting epoch exactly once and remains visible through the continuously refreshed checkpoint without another projection failure.
